rows.ARS:
Light yellow Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Rosanna Jacobs
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ludwig Taschner (South Africa, before 2011).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2011 as 'Rosanna Jacobs'.
rows.Bloom: Light yellow. Mild fragrance. Large, full (26-40 petals), globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, dense. Glossy foliage.

Height: up to 6'7" (up to 200cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
